DECLARE
 sh_no VARCHAR2(14);
 v_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function

 SELECT
 sh.shipment_no AS plasma_ship_no,
 gps.tube_ship_no,
 sh.consignee_id
 INTO sh_no, :ebl_ctrl_blk.tube_ship_no, :ebl_ctrl_blk.consignee_id 
 FROM
 shipments sh,
 consignee co,
 geltube_plasma_ship gps

 AND sh.shipment_no = :ebl_ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no
 AND co.consignee_id = sh.consignee_id
 AND sh.shipment_no = gps.plasma_ship_no(+)
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN co.eff_date AND nvl(co.term_date, v_sysdate + 365)
 AND sh.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND co.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND co.customer_id IN (SELECT cu.customer_id 
 FROM customers cu
 WHERE cu.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN cu.eff_date AND NVL(cu.term_date, v_sysdate+10)
 AND cu.customer_type = 'MG'
 AND cu.plasma_file_type = 'EBL'
 );

Exception

 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then

 IF ld_search_from_date IS NOT NULL OR ld_search_to_date IS NOT NULL THEN

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_UNIT (pl_unit_id in varchar2, pl_out out varchar2) IS
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 temp_ddc varchar2(1);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 sCOunt NUMBER:=0;
 cCount NUMBER:=0;
 pCount NUMBER:=0;
 kCount NUMBER:=0;
 fCount NUMBER:=0;
 nPacked NUMBER:=0;
 ProcString varchar2(240);
 
 cur_val varchar2(15) := name_in(name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'));
 do_checkin_validations BOOLEAN := TRUE;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := cur_val;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 -- get the proc1 string
 begin
 select code_desc into ProcString from vserv_master where
 code_type='EBLFL' and code='PROC1';
 exception when others then 
 handle_error;
 end; 
 
 pl_out:='OK';
 --check if unit is present in Units. Donor Decision Code will be validated later.
 BEGIN 
 SELECT nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from GELTUBE_PLASMA_DETAILS 
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id; 
 --AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 If nCount > 0 then 
 
 -- Check if the unit is already got packed
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nPacked from GELTUBE_PLASMA_PACK where
 unit_id = pl_unit_id and status_flag is not null; 
 
 If nPacked >0 then
 show_error_dist('6806'); 
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 
 -- check sCount from shipped products or pick_slip_products
 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.plasma_ship_no is not null then
 select nvl(count(*),0) into sCount from shipped_products where
 unit_id=pl_unit_id and shipment_no=:ctrl_blk_2.plasma_ship_no;
 Elsif :ctrl_blk_2.plasma_ship_no is null and :ctrl_blk_2.plasma_box_id is not null then 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into sCount from pick_slip_products where
 unit_id=pl_unit_id and nvl(box_id,' ')=:ctrl_blk_2.plasma_box_id ; --and product_status not in ('RT','RS');
 End If;
 

 If sCount >0 then 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into pCount from components a where 
 unit_id=pl_unit_id and instr(ProcString,substr(a.product_code,1,5),1) >0
 and relabel_product_code is null and system_label_decision not in ('Md','Mq');
 
 IF pCount > 0 then 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.plasma_box_id is not null then 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into pCount from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id=pl_unit_id and box_id=:ctrl_blk_2.plasma_box_id and
 product_status not in ('RT','RS','UN','RP');
 
 If pCount > 0 then 
 pl_out:='OK';
 Else
 show_error_dist('6803');
 check_package_failure;
 End If; 
 Else
 :geltube_plasma_pack.status_desc:='OK';
 pl_out:='OK';
 End If;
 
 ELSE
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into kCount from components where unit_id=pl_unit_id and
 product_code in (select code_desc from vserv_master where
 code_type='EBLFL' and code ='CRYO');
 If cCount > 0 then 
 show_error_dist('6804');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 select nvl(count(*),0) into fCount from components where unit_id=pl_unit_id and
 product_code in (select product_code from vserv_products where product_type in (
 select code from vserv_master where code_type='PRTPL'));
 
 If fCount > 0 then 
 show_error_dist('6801');
 check_package_failure; -- pl_out:='Product is changed to transfusible';
 Else
 show_error_dist('6805');
 check_package_failure; -- pl_out:='Non plasma product;
 End If;
 End If; 
 END IF;
 Else -- for scount
 show_error_dist('6802');
 check_package_failure; --pl_out:='Product is not in the shipment .......'; 
 End If;
 
 END IF; -- for nPacked 
 ELse -- for ncount
 show_error_dist('6800');
 check_package_failure;
 ENd If; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
 END;
END;

 init_local_times;

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt

 lv_chapterId CHAPTERS.CHAPTER_ID%TYPE;
 BEGIN
 
 init_local_times;
 
 IF p_eu_type IS NULL AND p_eu_code IS NOT NULL THEN

 RETURN;

 IF p_eu_code IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 
 IF p_chapter = 'ALL' THEN

 ELSE

 IF p_eu_type = 'PROD' THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM valid_products vp

 FROM vserv_master vm
 WHERE vm.code_type = 'PRTPL'
 AND euconfig.gd_localDate BETWEEN vm.eff_date AND NVL(vm.term_date, euconfig.gd_localDate + 10))
 AND euconfig.gd_localDate BETWEEN vp.eff_date AND NVL(vp.term_date, euconfig.gd_localDate + 10); 
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error_dist('6866');
 check_package_failure;

 ELSIF p_eu_type = 'LOCN' THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt

 WHERE chapter_id = NVL(lv_chapterId, chapter_id)
 AND location_id = p_eu_code
 AND euconfig.gd_localDate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, euconfig.gd_localDate + 10); 
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error_dist('6866');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF p_eu_type = 'IDCDE' THEN 
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM valid_collection_agencies
 WHERE coll_id = p_eu_code
 AND chapter_id = NVL(lv_chapterId, chapter_id)
 AND euconfig.gd_localDate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, euconfig.gd_localDate + 10);
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error_dist('6866');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF p_eu_type = 'FACLT' THEN
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM valid_master_codes vm
 WHERE vm.code_type = 'FACLT'
 AND vm.code = p_eu_code
 AND euconfig.gd_localDate BETWEEN vm.eff_date AND NVL(vm.term_date, euconfig.gd_localDate + 10);
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error_dist('6866');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 
 END validate_eu_code;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
